usedFor: Shopify holds your products, and Dust receives each one as a document through “Upload Document”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Upload Document” in Dust
bestTemplate.why: Each new product can be uploaded to a data source in Dust, so it works from your current catalog.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so anything sent to “Upload Document” arrives after a scheduled check.
